name: basic match returns stored title
spec_quote: A row's role is the `title` of the application whose `job_id` equals the row's `job_id` (the same field as the Tracker's Role).

name: surrounding spaces trimmed
spec_quote: The title is returned as stored, except that surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

name: surrounding tabs and newlines trimmed
spec_quote: The title is returned as stored, except that surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

name: internal whitespace preserved
spec_quote: The title is returned as stored, except that surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

name: missing job_id key gives dash
spec_quote: If the row has no job_id (empty / missing) ... the role is `—` (an em dash).

spec_quote: If the row has no job_id (empty / missing) ... the role is `—` (an em dash).
